title: City of Phoenix Preliminary Capital Improvement Program, 2026-2031 — Phase 65 TSMC Arizona delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the TSMC Arizona delivery reporting pack. Phoenix's preliminary six-year capital program lists department, project, funding-source, and schedule records, including $17,845,489 shown for the North Gateway Water Reclamation Plant in 2026-27.
key_findings: Project WS90320008 describes design and construction of a North Gateway Water Reclamation Plant near Interstate 17 and Dixileta Drive.
The preliminary schedule shows $17,845,489 for the project in 2026-27 across identified funding sources.
The program also identifies other water, wastewater, transportation, public-safety, and city infrastructure projects with distinct project codes and spending schedules.
why_it_matters: Which records separate campus construction, utility arrangements, workforce inputs, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat facility output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The CIP converts broad Phoenix infrastructure claims into named capital-program records that can be followed through adoption, procurement, construction, acceptance, and operation.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a named wastewater-infrastructure record to the Southwest local dossier.
Creates a project-code bridge to procurement, budget, contract, permit, and construction evidence.
Supports stage-aware analysis of industrial servicing without inferring facility capacity.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The reviewed document is preliminary and can change before or after adoption.
A programmed amount is not a solicitation, award, expenditure, completed asset, or operating capacity.
The project record does not prove service for a named customer, available treatment headroom, schedule performance, or environmental approval.
